about: What tools/gallery.mjs writes into examples/index.html besides what it reads from the models: each example's card text (the aspects of its notation it shows), its picture's alt text and its extra links, by file and, for a file with views of several types, by type; the map type's own description; and the Atlas's entries. tests/gallery.test.mjs fails when the committed page is not what the tool writes.

retired.about: Models of examples/ the gallery does not show: the real-world models that left it on 19 Nov 2026, the maintainer's decision, and bike-share.json, the hidden test and bench model. Their files stay until the bike share migration moves the tests and the bench off them and deletes them; until then the site still renders them, and the host pages that load them still work. No card, link or mention of them is on the gallery, the docs or the README.

map.name: Map
map.text: Layered architecture maps: cards, lines and boxes in views that open into each other, with stories, tours and lenses.

shapes.text: A card of each kind that has a shape, in the one style maps draw: people, a browser app, a phone, a window (a card's own shape), a terminal, an agent, a database, a queue, a file, a module, hosts, a hook and an external system.
shapes.alt: Card shapes: people, a browser app, a phone, a window, a terminal, an agent, a database, a queue, a file, a package, hosts and a hook around a shop's API

monorepo.text: A map generated from a dependency list by monorepo.py: a card per package, a line per import, heavier with more imports, a box per folder, nested as the folders are, and the same cards with no boxes.
monorepo.alt: A monorepo's packages, a box per folder, joined by their imports

sales-classes.text: Compartments of attributes and operations, an interface, an enumeration and a data type, composition and aggregation, generalization, realization, a «use» dependency and a note, each end with its role and multiplicity.
sales-classes.alt: A UML class diagram of a bookshop's sales domain: Customer, Order, OrderLine, Book, an abstract Payment and its CardPayment, the Payable interface, the OrderStatus enumeration, the Money data type and a note

order-objects.text: Instances of the bookshop's classes, each head name : Classifier underlined, slots as feature = value, and links with a name or roles by their ends.
order-objects.alt: A UML object diagram of one placed order: ada, a Customer, linked to order1042, an Order, its two order lines, the books they are for and the card payment, each with its slots

bookshop-packages.text: Packages as boxes holding what they own, a package inside a package, two classes named Order in two packages, «import», «access», «merge» and a dependency between them, and a profile applied by «apply».
bookshop-packages.alt: A UML package diagram of a bookshop: the packages shared, catalog, sales, payments with card inside it, and wholesale, each a box holding its classes, joined by imports, an access, a merge and a dependency, and the profile BookshopConventions, a closed folder that sales applies

checkout-sequence.text: Lifelines on a time axis, calls, a self-call, async messages, replies and a create, activation bars derived from the messages, alt and opt frames with their guards, and an interaction use.
checkout-sequence.alt: A UML sequence diagram of a bookshop's checkout: a shopper, the storefront, the api, payments and a receipt created on the way, their messages in time order with activation bars, an alt frame with an opt frame and an interaction use inside it

checkout-communication.text: The checkout's paid branch as lifelines joined by connectors, each link's messages a stack of numbered rows with an arrow toward the receiver.
checkout-communication.alt: A UML communication diagram of the same checkout: five lifelines joined by connectors, each link's messages a stack of numbered rows

shopping-use-cases.text: Actors as stick figures, use cases as ellipses with their extension points, the subject as a box holding them, and include, extend and generalization between them.
shopping-use-cases.alt: A UML use case diagram of a bookshop: a shopper, a member and a payment provider as stick figures, eight use cases as ellipses in the Online bookshop subject, includes and extends drawn dashed with their labels

fulfil-activity.text: Actions, object nodes and a data store, send and accept actions, decisions, merges, forks and joins, in lanes; a call behaviour action opens the activity it calls (its second view).
fulfil-activity.alt: A UML activity diagram of fulfilling an order in three lanes, Order worker, Warehouse and Email service: actions, an object node, a data store, a decision and a merge, a fork and a join, and a flow final

order-states.text: States with their activities, composite states as boxes with orthogonal regions, a choice, a fork and a join, a shallow history and a terminate, and transitions written trigger [guard] / effect.
order-states.alt: A UML state machine diagram of an order's life: Placed with its activities, a choice, a fork into the Parcel and Payment regions of Fulfilling, In delivery with a history, Cancelled and a terminate

buy-book-overview.text: Interaction uses and an inline interaction drawn with its sequence diagram inside, joined by the activity's control nodes and flows; each use opens its sequence view.
buy-book-overview.alt: A UML interaction overview diagram of buying a book: interaction uses for finding a book, checking out and emailing the receipt, a decision looping back through a merge, a fork and a join, and an inline interaction with its three lifelines

uml.sequence.text: The four sequence views the interaction overview's uses open: finding a book, the checkout, emailing the receipt and queueing the order, each a short exchange between lifelines.
uml.sequence.alt: A UML sequence diagram from the buying a book overview: finding a book

bookshop-components.text: Components nested in components, ports on their borders, delegations inward, assembly connectors, provided and required interfaces as a ball and socket, artifacts and their manifestations.
bookshop-components.alt: A UML component diagram of a bookshop: Shop API a box holding Checkout, ports on their borders with delegations between them, Orders as a ball with a socket, SignIn as a rectangle, an artifact manifesting Shop API

bookshop-deployment.text: Nodes, devices and execution environments as cubes, nested; artifacts deployed by nesting or by a «deploy» line; deployment specifications and communication paths.
bookshop-deployment.alt: A UML deployment diagram of a bookshop in production: devices and execution environments drawn as cubes and nested, artifacts deployed in them, communication paths labelled with their protocols

order-service-structure.text: A class's parts and ports, a part showing its type's ports, connectors through parts, open collaborations and collaboration uses with their role bindings.
order-service-structure.alt: A UML composite structure diagram of an order service: its ports on its border, four parts, two of them showing their types' ports, connectors between them, an open collaboration as a dashed ellipse and a collaboration use with its role bindings

bookshop-profile.text: Stereotypes with tag definitions extending metaclasses, a required extension, a profile applied to a package, and an element's tags in a compartment per stereotype; stereotypes applied anywhere in the model are checked against it.
bookshop-profile.alt: A UML profile diagram of a bookshop's modelling conventions: a profile holding metaclasses and stereotypes with their tag definitions, extensions with filled triangles, one marked required, a package applying the profile, and a class showing its stereotypes' tags

bookshop-timing.text: Lifelines on one linear time ruler, each a step line through its states or a band of values, messages at their times, duration and time constraints.
bookshop-timing.alt: A UML timing diagram of one charge: two lifelines as step lines through their states on a time ruler in milliseconds, a call and its reply between them at their times, a duration constraint and a time constraint

order-information-flow.text: Information items, and dashed «flow» lines between classifiers and actors, each saying what it conveys.
order-information-flow.alt: A UML information flow diagram of what travels with an order: a shopper, components and information items, joined by dashed flow lines each naming what it conveys

ebike-requirements.text: Requirements with their id and text in a frame with SysML's header; containment drawn with a crosshair; derive, satisfy, verify, refine, trace and copy, each checked as SysML says.
ebike-requirements.alt: A SysML requirement diagram of a city e-bike in a req frame: requirements with their ids and wrapped texts, containment crosshairs, blocks satisfying and test cases verifying them

ebike-blocks.text: Blocks, interface blocks, constraint blocks and value types with SysML's named compartments; composition, generalization and dependency.
ebike-blocks.alt: A SysML block definition diagram of a city e-bike in a bdd frame: blocks with named compartments of parts, values, constraints and ports, an interface block, constraint blocks and value types

ebike-structure.text: A block's parts, references and values inside its frame; proxy and full ports with flow arrows and conjugation; connectors with item flows.
ebike-structure.alt: A SysML internal block diagram of a city e-bike: the bike as the ibd frame holding its parts, ports on their borders with flow arrows, connectors carrying DC power and phase current

ebike-range.text: Constraint properties with their expressions, parameters on their borders, binding connectors to the block's value properties.
ebike-range.alt: A SysML parametric diagram of a city e-bike's range: constraint properties with rounded corners and their expressions, parameters on their borders bound to value properties

bookshop-c4.text: Typed C4 in five views on the map's card shapes: a system context, containers in their system's boundary, components, a dynamic view's numbered steps and deployment nodes holding instances; implied relationships drawn where a view hides an end.
bookshop-c4.alt: A C4 container diagram of a bookshop: the shopper and staff as people, the bookshop a dashed boundary holding its containers, a database as a cylinder, external systems in grey

bookshop-schema.text: Tables and their columns as rows, related in crow's foot or IDEF1X on one geometry: a composite key, a junction table, a nullable foreign key, a self-reference.
bookshop-schema.alt: An entity-relationship diagram of a bookshop's database: seven tables with their key columns first, related by crow's foot ends, identifying lines solid and the rest dashed

bookshop-data-flow.text: Levels in Yourdon or Gane and Sarson on one geometry: numbered processes, stores and external entities; a process opens its level, which is checked for balance, and the key D makes one.
bookshop-data-flow.alt: A data flow diagram of a bookshop, level 1: three external entities, three numbered processes and two data stores, joined by labelled data flows

returns-flowchart.text: Ten symbols, laid out down: terminators, processes, a decision with labelled exits, input/output, a predefined process, a document, a database, manual input, a delay and a connector.
returns-flowchart.alt: A flowchart of handling a returned book, laid out down: a start, input and manual input, a decision with yes and no exits, a delay, a database, a document, a connector and an end

bookshop-order-to-shipment.text: BPMN 2.0.2's Descriptive elements: pools and lanes, tasks, a collapsed sub-process that opens its own view, events with their markers, gateways, boundary events on an activity's border, message flows between pools, data, an annotation and a group.
bookshop-order-to-shipment.alt: A BPMN diagram of a bookshop's order to shipment: three pools, the bookshop's in two lanes, tasks, events and gateways joined by sequence flows, dashed message flows between the pools, a timer on the payment task's border

bookshop-opening-plan.text: A tree of topics laid out left and right of its root, branches as curves in the map's kind colours, edited by N, F2, Alt + arrows and drops; Mermaid mindmaps imported.
bookshop-opening-plan.alt: A mindmap of opening a bookshop: the root in the middle, six branches left and right, each in its own colour, joined by curves

bookshop-aws.text: Accounts, regions, VPCs, availability zones, subnets and security groups as nested boxes, each service or resource a card with its icon and full service name. On this site the icons are the vendor's own, fetched with AWS's terms accepted; in a copy of this repository the diagram draws glyphs until you fetch them with umlimator.py pack fetch aws. Umlimator is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Google or Microsoft.
bookshop-aws.alt: An AWS architecture diagram of a bookshop: a cloud, a region, a VPC, two availability zones, public and private subnets and a security group as nested boxes, fifteen services and resources drawn with their icons and full service names

bookshop-gcp.text: Groups nested as boxes titled with their kind, each product a card with its icon and full service name, lines to a group's border. On this site the icons are the vendor's own, fetched with Google's terms accepted; in a copy of this repository the diagram draws glyphs until you fetch them with umlimator.py pack fetch gcp. Umlimator is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Google or Microsoft.
bookshop-gcp.alt: A Google Cloud architecture diagram of a bookshop: a project, a region, a network, a subnetwork and two zones as nested boxes, nine products drawn with their icons and full service names

bookshop-azure.text: Subscriptions, resource groups, regions, virtual networks and subnets as nested boxes, each service a card with its icon and full service name. On this site the icons are the vendor's own, fetched with Microsoft's terms accepted; in a copy of this repository the diagram draws glyphs until you fetch them with umlimator.py pack fetch azure. Umlimator is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Google or Microsoft.
bookshop-azure.alt: An Azure architecture diagram of a bookshop: a subscription, a resource group, a region, a virtual network and two subnets as nested boxes, eight services drawn with their icons and full service names

atlas.name: The Umlimator Atlas
atlas.text: Umlimator's own model, drawn with umlimator: its parts and who uses each (a map), its system context and containers (C4), the core module's layers (a package diagram), the typed diagram families (a component diagram), the diff Action on a pull request (a sequence diagram) and umlimator's state machines (navigation, the story player, tours, the page's keys and the MCP page), joined by cards that open them.
atlas.alt: The Umlimator Atlas's overview: the author, an AI assistant, the model JSON, umlimator.py, the module, umlimator/all, the page, the MCP page, the host page, the element, the docs site and the diff Action, with GitHub and Chrome
stories: A pull request, from push to comment

views.overview: The atlas's root: umlimator's parts and who uses each, the Python parts in a box, line kinds (feeds, state, triggers) and weights, two cards whose views a host may load when opened, and a story along a pull request.
views.context: The system context: the author and the reader as people, umlimator as the system, the AI assistant, GitHub and Chrome as external systems.
views.containers: The containers inside umlimator's dashed boundary, each with its technology, and the relationships the context implies.
views.layers: The core module's layers in src/, each a package, joined by «import» as tools/build.mjs orders them.
views.registry: The typed families as components, each depending on the core's registry, which the typed canvas looks up.
views.diff-run: The diff Action on a pull request: an async start, calls and their replies, a self-call, and an alt frame on whether the token can write.
views.machines: How umlimator's machines relate: the page and the MCP page drive render()'s handle, a box holding the story player, navigation and tours, which report every change to MapState.
views.navigation: Navigation's states, a move at a time, with its loops back and run order numbered.
views.story: The story player's states, from entering a step to ended or stopped.
views.tour: A tour's or a replay's states: riding, held, at the end or cut short.
views.keys: The order the page's keys close its layers in, as boxes of states.
views.mcp: A page tool, step by step, from the assistant's call to the answer once a page has shown it.
